dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: Hey there! You here for a drink? Or some fun?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're one of the staff here?

dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: At The Flagship? Aw, haha, of course not. Do I look like I'd fit in? Or is it because I said something Demyan would say?

dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: It's just my way of being friendly. Though it seems you don't cotton to it too well.

dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: A little caution is wise — but in places like this, sometimes you have to lower your guard to get what you want. Or at least pretend to. Am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: I'm sure you've tried the Roulette Special already, hmm? In a place like this, if anything's worth recommending, it'd be the drinks, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: If you're tired and craving real food, swing by Speranza. Ahem... Not that I'm biased just because it's run by our folks. No misunderstandings, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: Well... Katya raised me, you see. I'm sure you understand. I don't mean to hide it, but on the other hand, there's no need to go around shouting it from the rooftops.
